technical_and_design_decisions: Each Spring XD module will be re-implemented as a Spring Cloud Stream (s-c-s) module using the existing XD module source code as the starting reference.
Module code adaptation will follow s-c-s conventions (channel bindings via @EnableBinding, common message conversion, and property-based configuration).
Ported modules (router, file, FTP, redis, gemfire) will be implemented as sinks; rabbit will be implemented as a source, matching the s-c-s sink/source contract.
The router module will be generalized so that existing routing rules from XD are translated to a Spring Cloud Stream-friendly router abstraction.
The FTP module will keep its XD file rotation/transfer semantics but expose them through standard s-c-s MessageHandler options.
HDFS support for HDP/PHD will reuse the existing HDFS module and add a configuration profile/compatibility layer so it can be deployed against the newer Hadoop distributions.
Migration documentation will live in the project reference guide and follow the same format as previous XD release migration notes.
Each ported module will ship with unit tests and at least one sample integration test; sink/source contract tests will be reused where possible.
assumptions: A single experienced developer is familiar with both Spring XD and Spring Cloud Stream internals, so no ramp-up/training time is included.
The original Spring XD module source code is accessible and self-contained enough to be ported without reverse-engineering.
Test infrastructure (CI, integration test harness for s-c-s) is already in place; only the per-module test wiring is required.
Dependency upgrades needed for HDP/PHD compatibility are limited to the HDFS module and do not require changes to the core framework.
No new external third-party licenses or vendor approvals are required for the ported modules.
A 'workday' is an effective focused development day of ~6 productive hours.
No production rollout, deployment, or operational handover effort is included; this estimate covers only the development increment.
Code review, refactoring, and minor documentation fixes are folded into the per-module and finalization activities rather than estimated separately per change.

activities.activity_name: Project setup and XD module analysis
activities.activity_description: Set up the s-c-s module project structure, dependency configuration, and analyze the existing Spring XD module code patterns to identify reusable abstractions and required API changes for all modules to be ported.
Port the XD router module into the s-c-s repo as a sink module. Implement routing rules, message evaluation logic, unit tests, and basic documentation for the s-c-s configuration model.

Port the XD file module into the s-c-s repo as a sink. Adapt file-writing semantics (rotation, naming, directory handling) to s-c-s MessageHandler abstractions, with unit tests and reference documentation.
Port the XD FTP module into the s-c-s repo as a sink. Handle FTP/FTPS connectivity, upload modes, and file-rotation options; add unit tests for core logic and a sample integration test for uploads.
Move the XD redis module to the s-c-s repo as a sink. Adapt the Redis client usage to a s-c-s sink contract, including serialization, key/value semantics, and unit tests.
Move the XD rabbit module to the s-c-s repo, this time as a source module. Adapt the AMQP client to the s-c-s source contract, including consumer configuration, message conversion, and unit tests.
Move the XD gemfire module to the s-c-s repo as a sink. Adapt GemFire client APIs (region writes, serialization, transactions) to the s-c-s sink contract, plus unit tests.
Update the HDFS module to support the latest HDP/PHD distributions, including Hadoop client version alignment, configuration profiles, and validation tests against the new distribution versions.
Author a migration strategy section covering new improvements introduced in 1.3 and explicit backward-incompatibility notes from 1.2, including upgrade steps and module/dependency mapping.
Run end-to-end streaming pipelines that exercise the new ported modules (e.g., rabbit -> router -> file/redis/FTP) and HDFS-based pipelines, fixing integration issues uncovered across modules.
Address code review feedback, finalize javadoc, align module configuration metadata, update release notes, and verify build/CI green across all ported modules and documentation.
